description: Database capacity & growth: total data/log, 24h/7d growth deltas, top growers, DB/file inventory, recovery model, percent-growth risks. Cross-link Database Space (used%) and Autogrowth (events).

targets.expr: sum(mssql_database_data_size_mb{job="sql_exporter", instance=~"$instance", db=~"${db:regex}"} + mssql_database_log_size_mb{job="sql_exporter", instance=~"$instance", db=~"${db:regex}"}) or vector(0)

topk(15, sum by (instance) (mssql_database_data_size_mb{job="sql_exporter", instance=~"$instance", db=~"${db:regex}"} + mssql_database_log_size_mb{job="sql_exporter", instance=~"$instance", db=~"${db:regex}"}))
max by (instance, db, recovery_model_desc, state_desc) (mssql_database_data_size_mb{job="sql_exporter", instance=~"$instance", db=~"${db:regex}"})
max by (instance, db, recovery_model_desc, state_desc) (mssql_database_log_size_mb{job="sql_exporter", instance=~"$instance", db=~"${db:regex}"})

max by (instance, db, recovery_model_desc, state_desc) (mssql_database_data_size_mb{job="sql_exporter", instance=~"$instance", db=~"${db:regex}"} + mssql_database_log_size_mb{job="sql_exporter", instance=~"$instance", db=~"${db:regex}"})
max by (instance, db, recovery_model_desc, state_desc) (clamp_min(delta(mssql_database_data_size_mb{job="sql_exporter", instance=~"$instance", db=~"${db:regex}"}[1d]), 0))
max by (instance, db, recovery_model_desc, state_desc) (clamp_min(delta(mssql_database_data_size_mb{job="sql_exporter", instance=~"$instance", db=~"${db:regex}"}[7d]), 0))
max by (instance, db, recovery_model_desc, state_desc) (clamp_min(delta(mssql_database_log_size_mb{job="sql_exporter", instance=~"$instance", db=~"${db:regex}"}[7d]), 0))

sum by (instance) (mssql_database_data_size_mb{job="sql_exporter", instance=~"$instance", db=~"${db:regex}"} + mssql_database_log_size_mb{job="sql_exporter", instance=~"$instance", db=~"${db:regex}"})

sum by (instance) (mssql_database_data_size_mb{job="sql_exporter", instance=~"$instance", db=~"${db:regex}"} + mssql_database_log_size_mb{job="sql_exporter", instance=~"$instance", db=~"${db:regex}"})
max by (instance, db, logical_name, type_desc, growth_mb, is_percent_growth, physical_name) (mssql_database_file_size_mb{job="sql_exporter", instance=~"$instance", db=~"${db:regex}"})

title: Collector database_size_growth
